description: Create or edit one machine, as the machines screen does. Omit id to create (name required); pass id to edit, where every omitted field keeps its value and an empty string clears it. Serial numbers are unique per account. operationId names the operation type the machine performs. Attached files and whether the machine is in use are left alone. Preview first; an edit lists each field that changes. Requires Write + manufacturing.execute on an unpinned operator credential. In-app assistants get a confirm card the user applies.

id.description: The machine id (GUID) to edit, from list_machines; omit to create.

idempotencyKey.description: Caller-generated idempotency key; required with previewReceipt to commit.

preview.description: Step 1 of the required two-step write: set true to validate and receive a structured preview plus a single-use previewReceipt. Nothing changes until the commit call.

previewReceipt.description: Step 2 of the required two-step write: the receipt returned by the preview call. Supply together with a fresh idempotencyKey to commit; calls without it are refused.

name: save_machine
title: Save Machine
